# Windsurf / Devin Desktop changelog — captured 2026-08-10
# https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog
# (sources.json still points at windsurf.com/changelog, a 308 cross-host redirect)

Newest entry is still **v3.6.27, August 1, 2026** — unchanged vs the 2026-08-09 capture, and still
HELD BELOW BAR (security/robustness fixes, not new capability):
  - Fixed Windows certificate store loading for HTTPS requests behind TLS-inspecting proxies.
  - The `edit`, `write`, `apply_patch` and `notebook_edit` tools now refuse to write through
    symlinks, preventing unintended file redirection.

v3.6.22 (Jul 29): deferred product analytics until account status resolves.  [below bar]
v3.6.21 (Jul 29, reported 2026-08-07): Browser Preview (ACP) letting remote agents reach local dev
servers; MCP OAuth "Authenticate" button; Plan Mode in Devin Local; editable command approvals;
Cascade Migration Wizard (hooks->skills->memories); worktree sessions; custom subagent config in flat
files; subagent default model; unified agent-session notifications; codemaps in editor tabs; base IDE
updated to VS Code 1.126.

## NEW SOURCE DRIFT (2026-08-10)
The sources.json Windsurf **docs** URL `https://docs.windsurf.com` now **307-redirects cross-host to
`https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/getting-started`**. This is in addition to the already-known
`windsurf.com/changelog` -> `docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog` 308. **BOTH Windsurf URLs in
sources.json now need updating.**

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change (one additional source redirect recorded).
